column1: # electron.timings.tsv — measured seconds per scenario of the electron lane, both
# modes together, read by ci/test/scenario-lane-shard.py to balance the lane's CI
# shards by time rather than by count. Measured in codetracer CI run 45822112077
# (scenario-lanes, its eight desktop legs, 2026-11-27): the gap between
# consecutive results of a leg, the larger of the shared-editor and Monaco runs,
# and never below the time run 45576175587 measured (a scenario that failed
# early there runs for longer once it records). A scenario not listed weighs the
# median of those listed. Re-measure from a run's lane logs when shards drift.
